blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The proposed P470-million waste-processing system remains subject to scrutiny as Mayor Nestor Archival explained the supplier’s justification for the higher price but stopped short of endorsing the cost. Archival said the more expensive proposal from the supplier, Suki Trading Corp., includes automatic garbage segregation equipment on top of two pyrolysis units, distinguishing it from an earlier P250-million configuration that relies primarily on manual segregation. “I would not say [the price is] valid,” Archival said in an interview. He clarified that he was relaying the supplier’s explanation rather than defending the proposed amount. This comes as Cebu City […]...
